nist_ssdf11.title: NIST SP 800-218 — Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1
nist_ssdf11.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
nist_ssdf11.scope: General secure software development framework; not specific to AI-assisted coding.
nist_ssdf11.use: Secure development process, review, provenance, release and vulnerability-prevention rationale.

owasp_secure_coding_ai.title: OWASP Secure Coding with AI Cheat Sheet
owasp_secure_coding_ai.scope: AI-assisted and agentic coding risks; does not replace general secure-coding guidance.
owasp_secure_coding_ai.use: Hallucinated dependencies, indirect prompt injection, MCP/tool safety, context leakage, agent permissions and human accountability.

owasp_agentic_top10_2026.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
owasp_agentic_top10_2026.scope: Agentic AI systems that plan, act or invoke tools; not universally applicable to non-agentic code completion.
owasp_agentic_top10_2026.use: Goal hijacking, tool misuse, identity/privilege abuse, agentic supply chain and runtime containment rationale.

openssf_ai_instructions.title: Security-Focused Guide for AI Code Assistant Instructions
openssf_ai_instructions.publisher: OpenSSF Best Practices and AI/ML Working Groups
openssf_ai_instructions.scope: Practical guidance for instructions/prompts used with AI code assistants; not a certification standard.
openssf_ai_instructions.use: Human responsibility, secure instructions, review, testing, dependency and secret-safety rationale.

owasp_asvs_500.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) 5.0.0
owasp_asvs_500.scope: Web application technical security verification standard; not every requirement applies to every software product.
owasp_asvs_500.use: Authentication, authorization, validation, configuration, data protection, logging and application-security verification rationale.

openssf_ai_slop_context.title: OpenSSF Vulnerability Disclosures WG — AI-Slop impact context
openssf_ai_slop_context.scope: OpenSSF uses AI-Slop in the narrower context of low-quality AI-generated vulnerability reports.
openssf_ai_slop_context.use: Terminology context only; this project defines its broader Anti-AI-Slop label independently.
